title: On parameter-dependent inhomogeneous boundary-value problems in Sobolev spaces
summary: We study a wide class of linear inhomogeneous boundary-value problems for $r$th order ODE-systems depending on a parameter $μ$ belonging to a general metric space $\mathcal M$. The solutions belong to the Sobolev spaces $(W^{n+r}_p)^m$, $n\in\mathbb{N}\cup\{0\}$, $m, r \in \mathbb{N}$, $1\leq p\leq \infty$. The boundary conditions are of a most general form $By=c$, where $B$ is an arbitrary continuous operator from $(W^{n+r}_p)^m$ to $\mathbb{C}^{rm}$.
